selectionRationale: Municipal neighbourhood or planning community boundaries are preferred to wards and federal census tracts. Full official source geometries are pinned without assigning census-tract statistics to them.

mississauga.chosen: Official custom 2021 neighbourhood Census geography, matching 56 All-gender profile rows exactly by Geog.
mississauga.currentPlan: Official Plan 2051 came into effect on March 24, 2026. The profile geography is a historical municipal reporting boundary, not a claim about current zoning.
mississauga.alternativeReasonNotUsed: Current plan geometry has not been shown to match the published 2021 custom tabulation. Do not attach those counts merely by name.
mississauga.definitionEvidence: mississauga-2021-census-legend.pdf is the official code legend included in the published CSV ZIP. The .txt companion is a text extraction for automated review.
mississauga.noMedianHouseholdIncome: IS_MI15M is median personal total income among recipients; ISNEF_MTI is income for people not in census families. Neither is median household income.
mississauga.geographicRepair: Streetsville NHD has a nested shell at the Streetsville CN area. make_valid yields a Polygon with a hole and zero overlap with Streetsville CN; buffer(0) incorrectly fills that hole.

alternativeStatistics: Peel Health Data Zones publish 2021 median household income and 13 visible-minority categories, but they are custom aggregates of census tracts, not the selected municipal community boundaries. Kept separate.
